meta.name: options
meta.description: Compare feasible approaches to a customer problem and recommend a path with costs, constraints and evidence. Use for an architecture or delivery decision, not implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较几种可行方案,给出带成本、约束和依据的建议路线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在动手实现前先比较几种方案、定下架构或交付路线。
copy.tagline_en: Compare feasible approaches and recommend a path with costs and constraints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must choose between approaches before building.

howto.what: 它会对比同一个客户问题下的几种可行做法，推荐其中一条，并说明成本、约束和依据。它用于架构或交付决策，不负责具体实现。
howto.when: 当你需要做架构或交付决策时触发，不接管具体实现。若由 @fde 调用，会复用其当前的脱敏数据包和范围，不重新做已答过的调研与设置。

say.text: 帮我比较这三个方案，推荐一条并列出成本和约束
say.note: 会给出推荐路径及其成本、约束与证据

say.text: 这个架构决策有哪些可行路径？各自取舍是什么
say.note: 会并列比较可行做法及取舍

say.text: 沿用 @fde 当前的数据包，比较这几种交付方案
say.note: 复用现有脱敏数据包，不重开调研

howto.what_en: It compares several feasible approaches to the same customer problem, recommends one path, and states its costs, constraints and evidence. It is for architecture or delivery decisions, not implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you face an architecture or delivery decision; it does not take over implementation. If called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope instead of restarting discovery.

say_en.text: Compare these three approaches and recommend one with costs and constraints
say_en.note: Returns a recommended path with costs, constraints and evidence

say_en.text: What feasible paths exist for this architecture decision, and their trade-offs?
say_en.note: Compares the feasible approaches and their trade-offs

say_en.text: Reuse @fde's current packet and compare these delivery approaches
say_en.note: Reuses the existing sanitized packet; no new discovery
